explanation_en: Fabada asturiana is an Asturian bean stew made with fabes and pork products such as chorizo and morcilla.
explanation_et: Fabada asturiana on Astuuria oahautis, milles kasutatakse fabes-ube ning sealihatooteid, näiteks chorizo’t ja morcilla’t.

clue_en: Córdoba’s chilled tomato-and-bread soup is much thicker than gazpacho and is often topped with egg and ham. Name it.
clue_et: Córdoba külm tomati-leivasupp on gazpacho’st palju paksem ning sellele lisatakse sageli muna ja sinki. Nimeta supp.
explanation_en: Salmorejo is a chilled Córdoba soup based on tomato, bread, olive oil and garlic; it is much thicker than gazpacho.
explanation_et: Salmorejo on Córdobast pärit tomati, leiva, oliiviõli ja küüslaugu põhine külmsupp, mis on gazpacho’st palju paksem.

clue_en: Galician fairground cooks slice boiled octopus and season it with olive oil, salt, and both sweet and hot paprika. Give the dish’s name.
clue_et: Galicia laadakokad lõikavad keedetud kaheksajala viiludeks ning maitsestavad selle oliiviõli, soola ning magusa ja terava paprikapulbriga. Anna roa nimi.
accepted_variants_en: pulpo a la gallega;polbo á feira
accepted_variants_et: pulpo a la gallega;polbo á feira
explanation_en: Pulpo a feira, also called polbo á feira, is Galician octopus served with oil, salt and paprika.
explanation_et: Pulpo a feira ehk polbo á feira on Galicia kaheksajalaroog, mida serveeritakse õli, soola ja paprikapulbriga.

clue_en: Catalonia roasts aubergines and red peppers until smoky, then dresses the peeled strips with olive oil. Identify this dish.
clue_et: Kataloonias röstitakse baklažaanid ja punased paprikad suitsuseks ning kooritud ribad maitsestatakse oliiviõliga. Tuvasta roog.
explanation_en: Escalivada is a Catalan preparation of smoky roasted vegetables, especially aubergine and red pepper, dressed with olive oil.
explanation_et: Escalivada on Kataloonia roog suitsuseks röstitud köögiviljadest, eeskätt baklažaanist ja punasest paprikast, mida maitsestatakse oliiviõliga.

clue_en: Norway’s sweet brown dairy block gets its colour and caramel flavour by boiling whey until its sugars concentrate. Name it.
clue_et: Norra magus pruun piimatoode saab värvi ja karamellise maitse vadaku keetmisel, kuni suhkrud kontsentreeruvad. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Brunost is Norwegian brown whey cheese whose characteristic flavour comes from caramelised milk sugars.
explanation_et: Brunost on Norra pruun vadakujuust, mille iseloomulik maitse tekib piimasuhkrute karamellistumisel.

clue_en: Finland’s eastern borderland gave its name to an open rye-crust pastry filled most familiarly with rice porridge. Identify it.
clue_et: Soome idapoolne piiriala andis nime lahtisele rukkikoorega pirukale, mille tuntuim täidis on riisipuder. Tuvasta see.
explanation_en: A Karelian pasty has a thin rye crust around a rice-porridge filling and is often served with egg butter.
explanation_et: Karjala pirukal on õhuke rukkikoor ja riisipudrutäidis ning seda serveeritakse sageli munavõiga.

clue_en: Swedes stack bread, creamy fillings and savoury garnishes into a chilled celebration dish that looks like a layer cake. Name it.
clue_et: Rootslased laovad leiva, kreemjad täidised ja soolased kaunistused külmaks piduroaks, mis näeb välja nagu kihiline tort. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Smörgåstårta is a Swedish savoury sandwich cake assembled in layers and decorated before serving cold.
explanation_et: Smörgåstårta on Rootsi soolane võileivatort, mis laotakse kihtidena, kaunistatakse ja serveeritakse külmalt.

clue_en: On the Swedish islands of Öland and Gotland, potato dumplings commonly hide a pork-and-onion filling. What are they called?
clue_et: Rootsi Ölandi ja Gotlandi saartel peidavad kartuliklimbid tavaliselt sealiha-sibulatäidist. Kuidas neid nimetatakse?
explanation_en: Kroppkakor are Swedish boiled potato dumplings, often filled with pork and onion.
explanation_et: Kroppkakor on Rootsi keedetud kartuliklimbid, mis täidetakse sageli sealiha ja sibulaga.

clue_en: Savonia encloses fish and fatty pork inside a dense rye loaf, baking the filling for hours. Give this Finnish speciality its name.
clue_et: Savonias suletakse kala ja rasvane sealiha tiheda rukkileiva sisse ning täidist küpsetatakse tundide kaupa. Anna sellele Soome eriroale nimi.
explanation_en: Kalakukko is a Savonian Finnish rye loaf baked with fish and pork sealed inside.
explanation_et: Kalakukko on Soome Savonia rukkileib, mille sisse suletakse küpsema kala ja sealiha.

category_name_en: Australia and New Zealand at the Table
clue_en: A crisp meringue shell with a soft centre, cream and fruit honours a Russian ballerina who toured Australasia in the 1920s. Name the dessert.
clue_et: Krõbeda beseekesta, pehme sisu, vahukoore ja puuviljadega magustoit austab 1920. aastatel Australaasias tuuritanud vene baleriini. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Pavlova is a meringue dessert topped with cream and fruit and named after ballerina Anna Pavlova.
explanation_et: Pavlova on vahukoore ja puuviljadega kaetud beseemagustoit, mis sai nime baleriin Anna Pavlova järgi.

category_name_en: Australia and New Zealand at the Table
clue_en: Rolled oats and golden syrup form the base of which Australasian biscuit associated with a First World War army corps? Some recipes also add coconut.
clue_et: Kaerahelbed ja kuldsiirup on aluseks millisele Esimese maailmasõja armeekorpusega seostatud Australaasia küpsisele? Mõnes retseptis lisatakse ka kookost.
explanation_en: ANZAC biscuits use rolled oats and golden syrup, may include coconut, and are associated with the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps.
explanation_et: ANZAC-küpsistes kasutatakse kaerahelbeid ja kuldsiirupit, neisse võidakse lisada kookost ning need seostuvad Austraalia ja Uus-Meremaa armeekorpusega.

category_name_en: Australia and New Zealand at the Table
clue_en: Māori cooks place baskets of food over heated stones in an earth pit, then cover them to steam for hours. Name the method.
clue_et: Maoori kokad asetavad toidukorvid maa-auku kuumade kivide kohale ja katavad need tundideks auruma. Nimeta meetod.
explanation_en: Hāngi is a traditional Māori method of cooking food with heated rocks in a covered earth oven.
explanation_et: Hāngi on maooride traditsiooniline viis küpsetada toitu kuumade kividega kaetud maa-ahjus.

category_name_en: Australia and New Zealand at the Table
clue_en: New Zealanders fold small pieces of honeycomb toffee into a plain vanilla frozen base. What local flavour results?
clue_et: Uusmeremaalased segavad vanillisesse külmutatud maiusse väikesi kärjekaramelli tükke. Milline kohalik maitse nii sünnib?
explanation_en: Hokey pokey ice cream is a New Zealand flavour combining vanilla ice cream with pieces of honeycomb toffee.
explanation_et: Hokey pokey jäätis on Uus-Meremaa jäätisemaitse, kus vanillijäätises on kärjekaramelli tükid.

category_name_en: Australia and New Zealand at the Table

clue_et: Milline frititud vürtsikas täidisega pirukas pärineb Rajasthani Marwari piirkonnast?
explanation_en: Kachori may be served with tamarind chutney or mint-and-green-chilli chutney.
explanation_et: Kachori’t võib serveerida tamarindi-tšatni või mündi-rohelise tšilli tšatniga.

clue_en: Which crumbly pastry, commonly used for pie and tart bases, is made by mixing fat into flour before adding liquid?
clue_et: Milline piruka- ja koogipõhjades levinud tainas valmib rasva segamisel jahusse enne vedeliku lisamist ning jääb küpsedes muredaks?
explanation_en: Coating flour with fat limits gluten formation, giving shortcrust pastry its tender, crumbly texture.
explanation_et: Jahu segamine rasvaga piirab gluteeni teket ja annab muretainale õrna, mureneva tekstuuri.

clue_en: Which high-moisture dough relies on steam to puff into éclairs and profiteroles?
clue_et: Milline niiskusrikas tainas paisub auru jõul ekleerideks ja profitroolideks?
explanation_en: Butter, water, flour and eggs give choux pastry enough moisture for steam to puff it during baking.
explanation_et: Või, vee, jahu ja munadega keedutainas sisaldab piisavalt niiskust, et aur selle küpsetamisel paisutaks.

clue_en: Which light pouring custard combines milk, sugar and egg yolks and is often flavoured with vanilla?
clue_et: Milline kerge valatav kreem ühendab piima, suhkru ja munakollased ning maitsestatakse sageli vanilliga?
explanation_en: Crème anglaise combines sugar and egg yolks with hot milk and is often flavoured with vanilla.
explanation_et: Crème anglaise ühendab suhkru ja munakollased kuuma piimaga ning seda maitsestatakse sageli vanilliga.

clue_en: Which almond-based mixture is used in a Bakewell tart?
clue_et: Millist mandlipõhist segu kasutatakse Bakewelli tardis?
explanation_en: Frangipane is commonly made from almonds, butter, sugar and eggs.
explanation_et: Frangipane valmistatakse tavaliselt mandlitest, võist, suhkrust ja munadest.

clue_en: Egg yolks, sugar and sweet wine whipped into an airy custard form which Italian dessert?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia magustoit valmib munakollaste, suhkru ja magusa veini vahustamisel õhuliseks kreemiks?
explanation_en: Sabayon is the French name for the dessert known in Italian as zabaione.
explanation_et: Sabayon on prantsuskeelne nimetus magustoidule, mida itaalia keeles tuntakse zabaione’na.

clue_en: Which Mexican breakfast serves fried eggs on tortillas with tomato-chilli salsa?
clue_et: Milline Mehhiko hommikusöök serveerib praemune tortiljadel koos tomati-tšillisalsaga?
explanation_en: Huevos rancheros follows the style of a traditional large mid-morning meal on rural Mexican farms.
explanation_et: Huevos rancheros järgib Mehhiko maafarmide traditsioonilise suure hilise hommikueine stiili.

clue_en: Which Malaysian coconut-rice dish is traditionally served with sambal, anchovies, peanuts and egg?
clue_et: Millist Malaisia kookosriisirooga serveeritakse traditsiooniliselt sambali, anšooviste, maapähklite ja munaga?
explanation_en: Nasi lemak is widely considered the national dish of Malaysia.
explanation_et: Nasi lemak’i peetakse laialt Malaisia rahvusroaks.

clue_en: Which Egyptian staple is a stew of cooked fava beans served with olive oil and cumin, with lemon juice among its optional additions?
clue_et: Milline Egiptuse põhitoit on keedetud põldubadest hautis, mida serveeritakse oliiviõli ja vürtsköömnega ning millele võib lisada sidrunimahla?
explanation_en: In Cairo, huge pots of fava beans were kept simmering to provide breakfast for the city’s population.
explanation_et: Kairos hoiti suuri põldoapotte podisemas, et pakkuda linnaelanikele hommikusööki.

clue_en: Which thin South Indian pancake is made from fermented rice batter and coconut milk?
clue_et: Milline õhuke Lõuna-India pannkook valmistatakse kääritatud riisitainast ja kookospiimast?
explanation_en: Appam is traditionally cooked in an appachatti, a deep pan shaped like a wok.
explanation_et: Appam küpsetatakse traditsiooniliselt appachatti’s, vokipanni kujulises sügavas pannis.

clue_en: Which South Indian savoury porridge begins with dry-roasted semolina?
clue_et: Milline Lõuna-India soolane puder algab kuivröstitud mannast?
explanation_en: Upma variations add or remove spices and vegetables.
explanation_et: Upma variatsioonides lisatakse või jäetakse ära vürtse ja köögivilju.

clue_en: Which fish paste is sold in many shapes and used to mimic crab, lobster or other shellfish?
clue_et: Millist kalapastat müüakse mitmel kujul ning kasutatakse krabi, homaari või muude koorikloomade jäljendamiseks?
explanation_en: Sucrose and other carbohydrates can act as cryoprotectants by stabilising surimi protein during freezing.
explanation_et: Sahharoos ja teised süsivesikud võivad toimida krüoprotektantidena, stabiliseerides surimi valku külmutamisel.

clue_en: Which Nordic fish preparation soaks dried whitefish in lye and then in water before cooking?
clue_et: Millise Põhjamaade kalaroa puhul leotatakse kuivatatud valget kala enne küpsetamist leelises ja seejärel vees?
explanation_en: Lutefisk develops a distinctive gelatinous texture during its treatment.
explanation_et: Lutefisk omandab töötlemise käigus iseloomuliku želatiinse tekstuuri.

clue_en: Which Japanese ingredient is simmered, smoked and fermented skipjack tuna?
clue_et: Milline Jaapani koostisosa on keedetud, suitsutatud ja fermenteeritud vööttuun?
explanation_en: Katsuobushi is shaved into flakes and used with kombu to make dashi.
explanation_et: Katsuobushi hööveldatakse helvesteks ning kasutatakse koos kombu’ga dashi valmistamiseks.

clue_en: What Portuguese term names dried and salted cod used in hundreds of dishes?
clue_et: Milline Portugali termin tähistab sadades roogades kasutatavat kuivatatud ja soolatud turska?
explanation_en: Drying and salting cod preserve its nutrients and change the fish’s taste.
explanation_et: Tursa kuivatamine ja soolamine säilitavad selle toitained ning muudavad kala maitset.

clue_en: Which Italian delicacy is a salted, cured and dried pouch of fish roe?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia delikatess on soolatud, laagerdatud ja kuivatatud kalamarjakott?
explanation_en: Bottarga is commonly made from grey mullet or bluefin tuna roe.
explanation_et: Bottarga’t valmistatakse tavaliselt kefali või hariliku tuuni marjast.

clue_en: Which savoury sensation is recognised as one of the five basic tastes?
clue_et: Millist täidlast maitseaistingut tunnustatakse ühe viiest põhimaitsest?
explanation_en: In 1908, Kikunae Ikeda identified umami as a distinct taste attributed to glutamic acid.
explanation_et: Kikunae Ikeda tuvastas 1908. aastal umami glutamiinhappega seotud eraldi maitsena.

clue_en: Which flavour enhancer is the sodium salt of glutamic acid?
clue_et: Milline maitsetugevdaja on glutamiinhappe naatriumisool?
explanation_en: Monosodium glutamate is a flavour enhancer made from the sodium salt of glutamic acid.
explanation_et: Naatriumglutamaat on glutamiinhappe naatriumisoolast maitsetugevdaja.

clue_en: Which East Asian mushroom is used fresh or dried and has a Japanese name combining the shii tree with “mushroom”?
clue_et: Millist Ida-Aasia seent kasutatakse värskelt või kuivatatult ning selle jaapanikeelne nimi ühendab shii-puu sõnaga „seen“?
explanation_en: Shiitake grows naturally on the decaying wood of deciduous trees and is widely cultivated.
explanation_et: Shiitake kasvab looduses lehtpuude kõduneval puidul ning seda kasvatatakse laialdaselt.

clue_en: Which edible kelp supplies glutamate to the Japanese stock called dashi?
clue_et: Milline söödav pruunvetikas annab glutamaati Jaapani puljongile dashi?
explanation_en: Kombu is widely eaten in East Asia and is one of three main ingredients used to make dashi.
explanation_et: Kombu’t süüakse laialt Ida-Aasias ning see on üks kolmest dashi põhikoostisosast.

clue_en: Which paste or powder is made from the soluble contents separated after yeast cells are broken down?
clue_et: Milline pasta või pulber valmistatakse pärast pärmirakkude lõhkumist eraldatud lahustuvast osast?
explanation_en: Yeast extract contains the amino acid glutamic acid and is used in spreads, soups and seasonings.
explanation_et: Pärmiekstrakt sisaldab glutamiinhapet, mis on aminohape, ning seda kasutatakse määretes, suppides ja maitseainetes.

clue_en: Which word became a household name for vacuum flasks that keep drinks hot or cold?
clue_et: Milline sõna sai üldtuntud nimetuseks vaakumpudelitele, mis hoiavad jooke kuuma või külmana?
explanation_en: In the United States, lowercase “thermos” was declared a genericised trademark in 1963.
explanation_et: Ameerika Ühendriikides tunnistati väiketähega „thermos“ 1963. aastal üldnimetuseks muutunud kaubamärgiks.

clue_en: Which plastic storage-container company developed the direct-marketing strategy known as the party plan?
clue_et: Milline plastist säilitusnõude ettevõte arendas otseturundusstrateegia, mida tuntakse peoplaanina?
explanation_en: Earl Tupper introduced the product line in 1946.
explanation_et: Earl Tupper tõi tootesarja turule 1946. aastal.

clue_en: Which Corning brand introduced heat-resistant glassware for kitchens in 1915?
clue_et: Milline Corningi kaubamärk tõi 1915. aastal turule köögi jaoks mõeldud kuumakindlad klaasnõud?
explanation_en: Pyrex was originally made from borosilicate glass.
explanation_et: Pyrexit valmistati algselt borosilikaatklaasist.

clue_en: Which screw-threaded glass preserving jar bears the surname of its 1858 American patentee?
clue_et: Milline keermega klaasist hoidisepurk kannab oma 1858. aasta Ameerika patendiomaniku perekonnanime?
explanation_en: John Landis Mason patented the preserving jar in 1858; its threaded mouth accepts a metal band that presses down a separate lid.
explanation_et: John Landis Mason patenteeris hoidisepurgi 1858. aastal; selle keermestatud suu võtab vastu metallrõnga, mis surub alla eraldi kaane.

clue_en: Which trademarked slow-cooker name began with an appliance marketed for cooking beans?
clue_et: Milline aeglase küpsetaja kaubamärk sai alguse ubade keetmiseks turustatud seadmest?
explanation_en: The Rival Company introduced the Crock-Pot name for its slow cooker in 1971.
explanation_et: Rival Company võttis oma aeglase küpsetaja jaoks nime Crock-Pot kasutusele 1971. aastal.

category_name_en: Staple Dishes of Africa and South America
clue_en: Which South African street food serves curry inside a hollowed-out loaf of bread?
clue_et: Millises Lõuna-Aafrika tänavatoidus serveeritakse karrit seest õõnestatud saiapätsi sees?
explanation_en: Bunny chow originated in Durban and turns a hollowed loaf into an edible container for curry.
explanation_et: Bunny chow pärineb Durbanist ning selles saab õõnestatud saiapätsist karri söödav anum.

category_name_en: Staple Dishes of Africa and South America
clue_en: Which West African pounded meal is made from cassava, plantain or cocoyam and eaten with broth-like soups?
clue_et: Milline Lääne-Aafrika tambitud roog valmistatakse maniokist, jahubanaanist või tarost ning süüakse leemetaoliste suppidega?
explanation_en: Fufu is made by pounding cooked starchy ingredients such as cassava, plantain or cocoyam into a smooth paste.
explanation_et: Fufu valmistamiseks tambitakse keedetud tärkliserikkad koostisosad, näiteks maniokk, jahubanaan või taro, ühtlaseks massiks.

category_name_en: Staple Dishes of Africa and South America
clue_en: Which maize flatbread is especially prominent in Colombia and Venezuela and may be stuffed with a filling?
clue_et: Milline maisijahust lameleib on eriti tähtis Colombia ja Venezuela köögis ning seda võib täidisega täita?
explanation_en: Arepas are made from ground maize dough and may be baked, grilled or fried.
explanation_et: Arepa’sid tehakse jahvatatud maisi tainast ning neid võib küpsetada, grillida või praadida.

category_name_en: Staple Dishes of Africa and South America
clue_en: Which spongy Ethiopian flatbread is traditionally made from fermented teff flour?
clue_et: Milline käsnjas Etioopia lameleib valmistatakse traditsiooniliselt kääritatud tefijahust?
explanation_en: Injera is a fermented flatbread traditionally made with teff; fermentation and cooking give it a spongy texture.
explanation_et: Injera on traditsiooniliselt tefijahust kääritatud lameleib, millele käärimine ja küpsetamine annavad käsnja tekstuuri.
source_title: FAO: The future is an ancient lake — tef

category_name_en: Staple Dishes of Africa and South America
clue_en: Which cooked maize meal is the staple food of Zimbabwe?
clue_et: Milline keedetud maisijahuroog on Zimbabwe põhitoit?
explanation_en: Sadza is commonly rolled into a ball by hand before being dipped into sauce, sour milk or stewed vegetables.
explanation_et: Sadza veeretatakse tavaliselt käega palliks ning kastetakse seejärel kastmesse, hapupiima või hautatud köögiviljadesse.

clue_en: Before arriving, diners make this booking so a restaurant will hold a table for them. Name it.
clue_et: Enne kohalejõudmist teevad sööjad selle broneeringu, et restoran neile laua hoiaks. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A table reservation is a booking made before arrival so a restaurant keeps a table available for the diners.
explanation_et: Laua broneerimine tähendab, et enne saabumist pannakse restoranis sööjate jaoks laud kinni.

clue_en: This service lets customers order and collect food without leaving their car. Name it.
clue_et: See teenus võimaldab klientidel toitu tellida ja kätte saada autost väljumata. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A drive-through serves customers while they remain in their vehicle for ordering and collection.
explanation_et: Drive-through võimaldab klientidel nii tellida kui ka toidu kätte saada autost lahkumata.

clue_en: At this kind of meal, diners choose from several shared dishes and serve themselves. Name it.
clue_et: Seda tüüpi einel valivad sööjad mitme ühise roa seast ja tõstavad endale ise toitu. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A buffet offers several shared dishes from which diners serve themselves.
explanation_et: Rootsi lauas on mitu ühist rooga, mille seast sööjad endale ise toitu tõstavad.

clue_en: This simple self-service dining place is commonly found at a school or workplace. Name it.
clue_et: See lihtne iseteeninduslik söögikoht asub sageli koolis või töökohal. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A canteen is a simple place at a school or workplace where people usually select and collect their own food.
explanation_et: Söökla on kooli või töökoha lihtne söögikoht, kus inimesed valivad ja võtavad oma toidu tavaliselt ise.

clue_en: A restaurant may add this fee to the bill for the service provided. Name it.
clue_et: Restoran võib lisada arvele selle tasu osutatud teeninduse eest. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A service charge is a fee added to a restaurant bill for providing service.
explanation_et: Teenindustasu on restoranis teeninduse eest arvele lisatav tasu.

clue_en: Buckets and a recipe described as eleven herbs and spices point to this three-letter fast-food chain. Name it.
clue_et: Ämbrid ning üheteistkümne ürdi ja vürtsi retsept viitavad sellele kolmetähelisele kiirtoiduketile. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: KFC is a fast-food chain known for bucket meals and a recipe described as a blend of eleven herbs and spices.
explanation_et: KFC on kiirtoidukett, mida tuntakse ämbris pakutavate einete ning üheteistkümne ürdi ja vürtsi seguna kirjeldatud retsepti järgi.

clue_en: This black-and-white filled biscuit is often twisted apart before it is eaten. Name the brand.
clue_et: Seda mustvalget täidisega küpsist keeratakse enne söömist sageli kaheks. Nimeta bränd.
explanation_en: An Oreo has two dark biscuit pieces around a pale sweet filling and is often eaten by twisting the halves apart.
explanation_et: Oreo koosneb kahest tumedast küpsisepoolest ja nende vahel olevast heledast magusast täidisest ning pooled keeratakse sageli lahku.

clue_en: The slogan “57 varieties” is closely associated with ketchup from this brand. Name it.
clue_et: Loosungit „57 sorti“ seostatakse tihedalt selle brändi ketšupiga. Nimeta bränd.
explanation_en: Heinz is a food brand whose ketchup has long been associated with the “57 varieties” slogan.
explanation_et: Heinz on toidubränd, mille ketšupit seostatakse juba ammu loosungiga „57 sorti“.

clue_en: This Nestlé instant-coffee brand joins the company name with the French word for coffee. Name it.
clue_et: Selle Nestlé lahustuva kohvi brändi nimi ühendab ettevõtte nime prantsuskeelse kohvisõnaga. Nimeta bränd.
explanation_en: Nescafé is Nestlé's instant-coffee brand, and its name combines Nestlé with the French word café.
explanation_et: Nescafé on Nestlé lahustuva kohvi bränd, mille nimi ühendab Nestlé nime prantsuskeelse sõnaga café.

clue_en: Frosties and Coco Pops boxes carry the name of this breakfast-cereal company. Name it.
clue_et: Frostiesi ja Coco Popsi pakenditel on selle hommikuhelbefirma nimi. Nimeta ettevõte.
explanation_en: Kellogg's is the breakfast-cereal company behind brands including Frosties and Coco Pops.
explanation_et: Kellogg's on hommikuhelbefirma, mille brändide hulka kuuluvad Frosties ja Coco Pops.

clue_en: A battered fish fillet beside thick fried potato pieces makes this famous British takeaway. Name it.
clue_et: Tainas praetud kalafilee koos paksude praetud kartulitükkidega moodustab selle kuulsa Briti kaasavõetava roa. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Fish and chips pairs battered fried fish with thick-cut fried potatoes and is a well-known British takeaway meal.
explanation_et: Kala friikartulitega ühendab tainas praetud kala ja paksud praetud kartulid ning on tuntud Briti kaasavõetav roog.

clue_en: Small breaded poultry pieces sold in fast-food boxes go by this name. Give it.
clue_et: Väikesi paneeritud kanalihatükke müüakse kiirtoidukarpides selle nime all. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Chicken nuggets are small pieces of poultry meat that are breaded and cooked as bite-size fast food.
explanation_et: Kananagitsad on väikesed paneeritud kanalihatükid, mida pakutakse suupärase kiirtoiduna.

clue_en: Crisp-coated wings or drumsticks cooked in hot oil make this takeaway favourite. Name it.
clue_et: Krõbeda kattega tiibadest või koibadest, mida küpsetatakse kuumas õlis, valmib see kaasavõetav lemmikroog. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Fried chicken consists of poultry pieces such as wings or drumsticks coated and cooked in hot oil until crisp.
explanation_et: Krõbekana koosneb kattega kanalihatükkidest, näiteks tiibadest või koibadest, mis praetakse kuumas õlis krõbedaks.

clue_en: Round slices cut from a layered bulb vegetable are coated in batter and fried for this side dish. Name it.
clue_et: Kihilise mugulköögivilja ümmargused viilud kaetakse tainaga ja praetakse selle lisandi valmistamiseks. Nimeta lisand.
explanation_en: Onion rings are round slices of onion coated in batter or crumbs and fried.
explanation_et: Sibularõngad on ümmargused sibulaviilud, mis kaetakse taina või paneeringuga ja praetakse.

clue_en: Seasoned meat shaved from a vertical rotisserie and placed in flatbread makes this Turkish takeaway. Name it.
clue_et: Püstvardalt lõigatud maitsestatud liha pannakse lapiku saia sisse selles Türgi kaasavõetavas roas. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Doner kebab is a Turkish dish of seasoned meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie, sliced off and commonly served in flatbread.
explanation_et: Döner kebab on Türgi roog, mille maitsestatud liha küpsetatakse püstvardal, lõigatakse sealt õhukeselt maha ja pannakse sageli lapiku saia sisse.

clue_en: This sharp green Japanese paste tastes similar to hot mustard or horseradish. Name it.
clue_et: See terav roheline Jaapani pasta maitseb sarnaselt kange sinepi või mädarõikaga. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Wasabi is a pungent green Japanese paste with a flavour often compared with hot mustard or horseradish.
explanation_et: Vasabi on terav roheline Jaapani pasta, mille maitset võrreldakse sageli kange sinepi või mädarõikaga.

clue_en: Small Cantonese dishes shared around the table and traditionally eaten with tea have this collective name. Give it.
clue_et: Väikesi Kantoni roogi, mida lauas jagatakse ja traditsiooniliselt tee kõrvale süüakse, nimetatakse selle koondnimega. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Dim sum is a Cantonese meal of small dishes traditionally shared at the table with tea.
explanation_et: Dim sum on Kantoni eine väikestest roogadest, mida traditsiooniliselt lauas jagatakse ja tee kõrvale süüakse.

clue_en: A glossy, sweet soy-based glaze defines this Japanese cooking style. Name it.
clue_et: Läikiv magus sojapõhine glasuur iseloomustab seda Jaapani valmistusviisi. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Teriyaki is a Japanese cooking style in which food is given a glossy glaze based on soy sauce and sugar.
explanation_et: Teriyaki on Jaapani valmistusviis, mille puhul toit saab läikiva sojakastmel ja suhkrul põhineva glasuuri.

clue_en: These thick, pale Japanese wheat noodles are often served in a hot broth. Name them.
clue_et: Neid pakse heledaid Jaapani nisunuudleid serveeritakse sageli kuumas puljongis. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Udon is a thick Japanese noodle made from wheat flour and commonly served in broth.
explanation_et: Udon on paks nisujahust valmistatud Jaapani nuudel, mida serveeritakse sageli puljongis.

clue_en: Small filled dough parcels floating in Chinese broth make this familiar menu dish. Name it.
clue_et: Väikestest täidisega tainataskutest Hiina puljongis koosneb see tuttav menüüroog. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Wonton soup is a Chinese broth containing small dough parcels wrapped around a filling.
explanation_et: Wontonisupp on Hiina puljong, milles on väikesed täidise ümber keeratud tainataskud.

clue_en: Dried noodle strands in a packet or cup need only hot water and a few minutes. Name this quick food.
clue_et: Pakis või topsis olevad kuivatatud nuudlid vajavad vaid kuuma vett ja mõnda minutit. Nimeta see kiire toit.
explanation_en: Instant noodles are dried noodles sold with seasoning in a packet or cup and prepared in minutes with hot water.
explanation_et: Kiirnuudlid on maitseainega pakis või topsis müüdavad kuivatatud nuudlid, mis valmivad kuuma veega mõne minutiga.

clue_en: This topped flat round is stored below zero until it goes into the oven. Name it.
clue_et: Seda kattega lamedat ümmargust toitu hoitakse miinuskraadidel, kuni see läheb ahju. Nimeta toit.
explanation_en: This prepared topped round is stored below zero and baked before eating.
explanation_et: Külmutatud pitsa valmistatakse koos kattega, hoitakse sügavkülmas ja küpsetatakse enne söömist.

clue_en: This complete prepackaged dish needs no preparation beyond heating and may be warmed in its own tray. Name it.
clue_et: See terviklik pakendatud roog ei vaja peale soojendamise muud valmistamist ja seda võib kuumutada oma alusel. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: A ready meal is a fresh or frozen prepackaged dish that only needs heating, sometimes in its own packaging.
explanation_et: Valmistoit on värske või külmutatud pakendatud roog, mida on vaja ainult soojendada, mõnikord samas pakendis.

clue_en: This compact packaged snack bar takes its first word from the quantity that food labels measure in calories or kilojoules. Name it.
clue_et: Selle väikese pakendatud batooni nime esimene pool viitab näitajale, mida toidupakendil väljendatakse kalorites või kilodžaulides. Nimeta batoon.
explanation_en: An energy bar is a compact packaged snack designed to provide food energy conveniently.
explanation_et: Energiabatoon on väike pakendatud suupiste, mis on mõeldud mugavaks energia saamiseks.

clue_en: Kernels sold in a folded paper bag expand along with the bag as they heat. Name this snack.
clue_et: Volditud paberkotis müüdavad terad paisuvad kuumutamisel koos kotiga. Nimeta see suupiste.
explanation_en: Microwave popcorn comes as kernels in a folded paper bag that expands while the kernels pop during heating.
explanation_et: Mikrolainepopkorni terad on volditud paberkotis, mis terade kuumutamisel ja paisumisel suuremaks muutub.

clue_en: Leaves from the vegetable also used for sauerkraut are cooked and wrapped around a savoury meat-and-grain filling. Name these parcels.
clue_et: Hapukapsa valmistamiseks kasutatava köögivilja lehed keedetakse ning keeratakse soolase liha- ja teraviljatäidise ümber. Nimeta need pakikesed.
explanation_en: Cabbage rolls are cooked cabbage leaves wrapped around a savoury filling that often combines meat and grain.
explanation_et: Kapsarullid on keedetud kapsalehed, mis keeratakse sageli lihast ja teraviljast koosneva soolase täidise ümber.

clue_en: Short pasta covered in a creamy cheese sauce makes this comfort-food favourite. Name it.
clue_et: Lühikesed makaronid kreemises juustukastmes moodustavad selle koduse lemmikroa. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Mac and cheese combines cooked macaroni with a creamy cheese sauce.
explanation_et: Makaronid juustuga on roog, milles keedetud makaronid kaetakse kreemja juustukastmega.

clue_en: This warm poultry broth is often served to someone who has a cold. Name the dish.
clue_et: Seda sooja linnulihapuljongit pakutakse sageli külmetunud inimesele. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Chicken soup is a warm broth made with poultry and is commonly eaten as comfort food during a cold.
explanation_et: Kanasupp on soe linnulihast valmistatud puljong, mida süüakse külmetuse ajal sageli lohutustoiduna.

clue_en: Seasoned minced meat is shaped like a loaf of bread and baked for this dish. Name it.
clue_et: Selle roa valmistamiseks vormitakse maitsestatud hakkliha leivapätsi kujuliseks ja küpsetatakse. Nimeta roog.
explanation_en: Meatloaf is made by shaping seasoned minced meat into a loaf and baking it.
explanation_et: Pikkpoiss valmistatakse maitsestatud hakkliha pätsiks vormides ja küpsetades.

clue_en: Bread slices are browned around a layer of melted cheese in this hot sandwich. Name it.
clue_et: Selle kuuma võileiva valmistamisel röstitakse saiaviilud, mille vahel on kiht sulanud juustu. Nimeta võileib.
explanation_en: A grilled cheese sandwich is made by browning bread around a filling dominated by melted cheese.
explanation_et: Juusturöstsai valmistatakse saiaviile pruunistades nii, et nendevaheline täidis koosneb peamiselt sulanud juustust.

clue_en: Thin crisp potato slices are sold salted in a snack bag under this name. Give it.
clue_et: Õhukesi krõbedaid kartuliviile müüakse soolasena suupistepakis selle nime all. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Potato chips are thin slices of potato cooked until crisp and commonly sold salted in bags.
explanation_et: Kartulikrõpsud on õhukesed krõbedaks küpsetatud kartuliviilud, mida müüakse sageli soolasena pakis.

clue_en: Thick skin-on potato pieces are cut lengthwise and baked or fried until crisp outside. Name this side.
clue_et: Paksud koorega kartulitükid lõigatakse pikuti ja küpsetatakse või praetakse väljast krõbedaks. Nimeta lisand.
explanation_en: Potato wedges are thick lengthwise pieces of potato, often left with the skin on, then baked or fried.
explanation_et: Kartulilohud on paksud pikuti lõigatud kartulitükid, millele jäetakse sageli koor ning mis seejärel küpsetatakse või praetakse.

clue_en: Colourful chewy sweets shaped like tiny bears have this familiar name. Give it.
clue_et: Värvilistel nätsketel maiustustel, mis on väikeste karude kujulised, on see tuttav nimi. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Gummy bears are small, chewy, colourful sweets moulded into the shape of bears.
explanation_et: Kummikommikarud on väikesed nätsked värvilised maiustused, mis vormitakse karude kujuliseks.

clue_en: Elongated cheese pieces are coated in batter or breadcrumbs and usually served as an appetiser. Name them.
clue_et: Pikad juustutükid kaetakse taina või riivsaiaga ja serveeritakse tavaliselt eelroana. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Mozzarella sticks are elongated pieces of mozzarella coated in batter or breadcrumbs and usually served as an appetiser.
explanation_et: Mozzarellapulgad on pikad mozzarella tükid, mis kaetakse taina või riivsaiaga ja mida serveeritakse tavaliselt eelroana.

clue_en: Light airy corn snacks coated in cheese-flavoured powder go by this name. Give it.
clue_et: Kergeid õhulisi maisisuupisteid, mis on kaetud juustumaitselise pulbriga, nimetatakse selle nimega. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Cheese puffs are airy puffed-corn snacks covered with cheese-flavoured powder.
explanation_et: Juustupallid on õhulised paisutatud maisist suupisted, mis kaetakse juustumaitselise pulbriga.

clue_en: This cartoon sailor becomes strong after opening a can of leafy greens. Name him.
clue_et: See multifilmimeremees muutub tugevaks pärast roheliste lehtede konservi avamist. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Popeye is a cartoon sailor whose strength increases after he eats canned leafy greens.
explanation_et: Popeye on multifilmimeremees, kelle jõud kasvab pärast roheliste lehtede konservi söömist.

clue_en: This clown character is the primary mascot of a global burger chain. Name him.
clue_et: See klounitegelane on üleilmse burgeriketi peamine maskott. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Ronald McDonald is the clown character used as the primary mascot of a global fast-food chain.
explanation_et: Ronald McDonald on klounitegelane, keda üleilmne kiirtoidukett kasutab oma peamise maskotina.

clue_en: This furry blue Sesame Street puppet is famous for eagerly devouring baked treats. Name him.
clue_et: See karvane sinine Seesamitänava nukk on tuntud küpsetatud maiuste innuka söömise poolest. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Cookie Monster is the furry blue Sesame Street puppet known for his enthusiastic appetite for baked treats.
explanation_et: Küpsisekoletis on karvane sinine Seesamitänava nukk, keda tuntakse tema tohutu küpsetatud maiuste isu poolest.

clue_en: Matt LeBlanc plays this food-loving sitcom character whose emphatic rule is that he does not share food. Name him.
clue_et: Matt LeBlanc kehastab seda sööki armastavat komöödiategelast, kelle kindel reegel on, et ta ei jaga toitu. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Joey Tribbiani is Matt LeBlanc's food-loving sitcom character, remembered for insisting that he does not share food.
explanation_et: Joey Tribbiani on Matt LeBlanci kehastatud sööki armastav komöödiategelane, kelle tuntud reegel on, et ta ei jaga toitu.

clue_en: This money-loving red crab owns an underwater fast-food restaurant. Name him.
clue_et: Sellele rahahimulisele punasele krabile kuulub veealune kiirtoidurestoran. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Mr. Krabs is a money-loving red crab who owns an underwater fast-food restaurant.
explanation_et: Härra Krabs on rahahimuline punane krabi, kellele kuulub veealune kiirtoidurestoran.

clue_en: This powdered blend combines the dry ingredients needed to make a cake. Name it.
clue_et: See pulbriline segu ühendab koogi valmistamiseks vajalikud kuivained. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A cake mix is a powdered blend of dry ingredients prepared for making a cake.
explanation_et: Koogisegu on koogi valmistamiseks mõeldud kuivainete pulbriline segu.

clue_en: Small drops of chocolate are folded into batter before baking. Name these cupboard ingredients.
clue_et: Need väikesed vormitud šokolaadipalad segatakse enne küpsetamist tainasse. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Chocolate chips are small shaped pieces of chocolate made to be mixed into dough or batter for baking.
explanation_et: Šokolaaditükid on väikesed vormitud šokolaadipalad, mis segatakse küpsetamisel tainasse.

clue_en: This unsweetened brown baking ingredient comes from cacao beans and flavours chocolate cakes. Name it.
clue_et: See kakaoubadest saadud magustamata pruun küpsetusaine annab šokolaadikookidele maitse. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Cocoa powder is an unsweetened brown product of cacao beans used to give baked goods a chocolate flavour.
explanation_et: Kakaopulber on kakaoubadest saadud magustamata pruun toode, millega antakse küpsetistele šokolaadimaitse.

clue_en: This fine white maize product is stirred into sauces to make them thicker. Name it.
clue_et: Seda peent valget maisitoodet segatakse kastmetesse, et neid paksendada. Nimeta aine.
explanation_en: Cornstarch is a fine white starch made from maize and commonly used to thicken sauces.
explanation_et: Maisitärklis on maisist saadud peen valge tärklis, mida kasutatakse sageli kastmete paksendamiseks.

clue_en: This fragrant baking liquid is traditionally made by soaking aromatic pods. Name it.
clue_et: Seda lõhnavat küpsetusvedelikku valmistatakse traditsiooniliselt aromaatseid kaunu leotades. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Vanilla extract is a flavouring liquid made by soaking or macerating vanilla pods in alcohol and water.
explanation_et: Vanilliekstrakt on maitsevedelik, mida valmistatakse vanillikaunu alkoholi ja vee lahuses leotades.

clue_en: This familiar dairy drink is treated so that its natural sugar is removed or broken down. Name it.
clue_et: Seda tuttavat piimajooki töödeldakse nii, et selle looduslik suhkur eemaldatakse või lagundatakse. Nimeta jook.
explanation_en: Lactose-free milk is treated by removing its lactose or breaking that sugar down with an enzyme.
explanation_et: Laktoosivaba piima valmistamisel eemaldatakse sellest laktoos või lagundatakse see suhkur ensüümi abil.

clue_en: This mild fresh dairy product has visible small curds and is commonly sold in tubs. Name it.
clue_et: See mahe värske piimatoode on nähtavalt teraline ja seda müüakse sageli topsis. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Cottage cheese is a mild fresh cheese made of small, visible curds and often packaged in a tub.
explanation_et: Kodujuust on mahe värske piimatoode, mis koosneb väikestest nähtavatest teradest ja mida müüakse sageli topsis.

clue_en: This standard white dairy drink keeps its usual fat content instead of having cream removed. Name it.
clue_et: Selle tavalise valge piimajoogi rasvasisaldust ei vähendata koore eemaldamisega. Nimeta jook.
explanation_en: Whole milk retains its normal milk-fat level rather than having fat reduced through the removal of cream.
explanation_et: Täispiimas säilib tavapärane piimarasvasisaldus, sest seda ei vähendata koore eemaldamisega.

clue_en: Exposure to smoke gives this cheese a distinctive flavour and a brownish rind. Name it.
clue_et: Suitsuga kokkupuutel saab see juust erilise maitse ja pruunika kooriku. Nimeta juust.
explanation_en: Smoked cheese is exposed to smoke, which gives it a characteristic flavour and often a brownish outer colour.
explanation_et: Suitsujuust puutub kokku suitsuga, mis annab sellele iseloomuliku maitse ja sageli pruunika välispinna.

clue_en: Souring milk and straining the curds produces this soft white unaged dairy product. Name it.
clue_et: Piima hapendamisel ja kalgendi nõrutamisel saadakse see pehme valge laagerdamata piimatoode. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Quark is a soft white unaged dairy product made by souring milk and straining the resulting curds.
explanation_et: Kohupiim on pehme valge laagerdamata piimatoode, mis valmistatakse piima hapendades ja tekkinud kalgendit nõrutades.

clue_en: This everyday drinking supply comes straight from an indoor household faucet. Name it.
clue_et: See igapäevane joogivesi tuleb kodus otse siseruumis asuvast segistist. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Tap water is drinking water supplied through indoor plumbing to a faucet.
explanation_et: Kraanivesi on joogivesi, mis jõuab siseruumis asuva kraanini torustiku kaudu.

clue_en: A still bottled drink has fruit or another flavour added and may also contain sweeteners or vitamins. Name the drink type.
clue_et: Sellele gaseerimata pudelijoogile lisatakse puuvilja- või muud maitset ning vahel ka magustajaid või vitamiine. Nimeta joogiliik.
explanation_en: Flavoured water is non-carbonated water with added flavouring and may also include sweeteners or vitamins.
explanation_et: Maitsestatud vesi on gaseerimata vesi, millele on lisatud maitset ning vahel ka magustajaid või vitamiine.

clue_en: Marketed as a pick-me-up for alertness and often containing caffeine, this beverage has what generic name?
clue_et: Seda jooki müüakse erksuse suurendajana ning see sisaldab sageli kofeiini. Mis on selle joogiliigi üldnimetus?
explanation_en: Energy drinks are marketed to increase alertness and commonly contain caffeine.
explanation_et: Energiajooke müüakse erksuse suurendajatena ning need sisaldavad sageli kofeiini.

clue_en: Carrots or tomatoes are pressed or blended into this savoury drink. Name it.
clue_et: Porganditest või tomatitest pressitakse või püreestatakse see soolakas jook. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Vegetable juice is made by blending vegetables or extracting their liquid; carrots and tomatoes are common ingredients.
explanation_et: Köögiviljamahla saadakse köögiviljade püreestamisel või neist vedeliku pressimisel; sageli kasutatakse porgandeid või tomateid.

clue_en: The clear liquid naturally found inside a young green tropical fruit is sold as this drink. Name it.
clue_et: Noore rohelise troopilise vilja sees leiduvat läbipaistvat vedelikku müüakse selle joogina. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Coconut water is the clear liquid naturally found inside young green coconuts.
explanation_et: Kookosvesi on läbipaistev vedelik, mida leidub looduslikult noorte roheliste kookospähklite sees.

clue_en: Removing the outer skin from an apple, potato or carrot before eating or cooking is called this. Name the action.
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse õuna, kartuli või porgandi väliskihi eemaldamist enne söömist või toiduvalmistamist?
explanation_en: Peeling is the action of removing an outer skin or layer from food.
explanation_et: Koorimine tähendab toidu väliskihi või koore eemaldamist.

clue_en: Rubbing a carrot across a surface of sharp holes to make small shreds is this kitchen action. Name it.
clue_et: Porgandi hõõrumine vastu teravate aukudega pinda, et saada väikesed ribad, on see köögitoiming. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Grating reduces food to small shreds by rubbing it against a surface with sharp projections or holes.
explanation_et: Riivimisel hõõrutakse toitu vastu teravate sakkide või aukudega pinda, et saada väikesed ribad.

clue_en: Passing a dry ingredient through fine mesh to remove lumps is this preparation action. Name it.
clue_et: Kuivaine laskmine läbi peene võrgu, et eemaldada tükid, on see ettevalmistustoiming. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Sieving passes an ingredient through a mesh so that lumps or larger particles are left behind.
explanation_et: Sõelumisel lastakse kuivaine läbi võrgu, nii et tükid või suuremad osakesed jäävad järele.

clue_en: Pounding a steak before cooking so it becomes less tough is this preparation step. Name it.
clue_et: Steigi tampimine enne küpsetamist, et see muutuks vähem sitkeks, on see ettevalmistusvõte. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Meat tenderising can be done mechanically by pounding a piece so it becomes less tough.
explanation_et: Liha pehmendamiseks võib tükki tampida, et see muutuks vähem sitkeks.

clue_en: Adding a final edible decoration to a plated dish just before serving is this finishing action. Name it.
clue_et: Viimase söödava kaunistuse lisamine taldrikul olevale roale vahetult enne serveerimist on see viimistlustoiming. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Garnishing means adding a decorative edible element to food before it is served.
explanation_et: Garneerimine tähendab toidule enne serveerimist kaunistava söödava elemendi lisamist.

clue_en: This extra-cold appliance compartment keeps stored food below its freezing point. Name it.
clue_et: See seadmeosa hoiab säilitatavat toitu külmumispunktist madalamal temperatuuril. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A freezer is an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen at very low temperatures.
explanation_et: Sügavkülmik on seade või seadmeosa, mis hoiab toitu väga madalal temperatuuril külmununa.

clue_en: Stretch this thin transparent plastic sheet over a bowl of leftovers to cover it. Name it.
clue_et: See õhuke läbipaistev plastleht tõmmatakse toidujääkidega kausi peale. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Cling film is a thin transparent plastic sheet used to cover food and seal containers.
explanation_et: Toidukile on õhuke läbipaistev plastleht, mida kasutatakse toidu katmiseks ja anumate sulgemiseks.

clue_en: Press two interlocking tracks together to close this flexible plastic food pouch. Name it.
clue_et: Selle painduva plastpakendi sulgemiseks surutakse kaks haakuvat riba kokku. Nimeta pakend.
explanation_en: A zipper storage bag is a flexible plastic pouch closed by pressing together two interlocking tracks.
explanation_et: Sulguriga säilituskott on painduv plastpakend, mis suletakse kahe haakuva riba kokkusurumisel.

clue_en: Preserves often keep in this rigid transparent container with a wide mouth and screw lid. Name it.
clue_et: Hoidiseid hoitakse sageli selles jäigas läbipaistvas laia suu ja keeratava kaanega anumas. Nimeta anum.
explanation_en: A glass jar is a rigid wide-mouthed container with a lid, commonly used for preserves.
explanation_et: Klaaspurk on jäik laia suuga kaanega anum, mida kasutatakse sageli hoidiste jaoks.

clue_en: Dry groceries and kitchen supplies are kept in this small room or cupboard. Name it.
clue_et: Kuivaineid ja köögitarbeid hoitakse selles väikeses ruumis või kapis. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A pantry is a small room or cupboard used to store food, groceries and kitchen supplies.
explanation_et: Sahver on väike ruum või kapp toidu, kuivainete ja köögitarvete hoidmiseks.

clue_en: Look for this package panel to see everything used to make the product. Name it.
clue_et: Sellest pakendi osast näeb kõiki toote valmistamiseks kasutatud aineid. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: An ingredients list tells consumers which substances were used to make a packaged food.
explanation_et: Koostisosade loetelu näitab tarbijale, milliseid aineid pakendatud toidu valmistamiseks kasutati.

clue_en: Energy, fat, carbohydrate and protein amounts appear together in this package table. Name it.
clue_et: Energia, rasva, süsivesikute ja valgu kogused on koos selles pakenditabelis. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A nutrition label reports a food's energy value and amounts of nutrients such as fat, carbohydrate and protein.
explanation_et: Toitumisalane teave näitab toidu energiasisaldust ning toitainete, näiteks rasva, süsivesikute ja valgu koguseid.

clue_en: This highlighted package text tells shoppers about substances that could trigger a serious reaction. Name it.
clue_et: See pakendil esile tõstetud tekst teavitab ostjat ainetest, mis võivad põhjustada tõsise reaktsiooni. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: An allergen warning highlights substances in a food that may cause allergic reactions.
explanation_et: Allergeenihoiatus tõstab esile toidus olevad ained, mis võivad põhjustada allergilisi reaktsioone.

clue_en: Besides figures per 100 grams, a package may optionally give values for this suggested amount eaten at one time. Name it.
clue_et: Lisaks saja grammi väärtustele võib pakend vabatahtlikult näidata andmeid selle soovitusliku korraga söödava koguse kohta. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: EU rules allow nutrition values per serving or consumption unit in addition to the standard values per 100 grams or millilitres.
explanation_et: ELi reeglid lubavad näidata toitumisväärtusi portsjoni või tarbimisühiku kohta lisaks tavapärastele saja grammi või milliliitri väärtustele.

clue_en: This package date is about food quality, unlike the safety deadline used for highly perishable products. Name the label.
clue_et: See pakendikuupäev näitab toidu kvaliteeti, mitte kiiresti rikneva toidu ohutustähtaega. Nimeta märge.
explanation_en: A best-before date concerns food quality, while a use-by date concerns safety for highly perishable food.
explanation_et: „Parim enne“ märge puudutab toidu kvaliteeti, kuid „kõlblik kuni“ kuupäev kiiresti rikneva toidu ohutust.
source_title: GOV.UK: Best before and use-by dates

clue_en: A thin sponge is spread with a sweet filling, rolled up, then sliced to reveal a spiral. Name the bake.
clue_et: Õhuke biskviit kaetakse magusa täidisega, keeratakse rulli ja lõigatakse spiraalse mustriga viiludeks. Nimeta küpsetis.
explanation_en: A Swiss roll is a thin filled sponge cake rolled into a cylinder and sliced to show a spiral.
explanation_et: Rullbiskviit on õhuke täidisega biskviit, mis keeratakse silindriks ja lõigatakse spiraalse mustriga viiludeks.

clue_en: This small cake for one person is baked in a paper case and often finished with icing. Name it.
clue_et: See väike ühele sööjale mõeldud kook küpsetatakse pabervormis ja kaetakse sageli glasuuriga. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A cupcake is a small cake designed for one person and is often topped with icing or decorations.
explanation_et: Tassikook on ühele sööjale mõeldud väike kook, mille peal on sageli glasuur või kaunistused.

clue_en: Name the sweet fried ring with a hole through its middle.
clue_et: Nimeta magus praetud rõngas, mille keskel on auk.
explanation_en: A doughnut is a sweet fried pastry that is often shaped like a ring with a central hole.
explanation_et: Sõõrik on magus praetud küpsetis, mis on sageli rõngakujuline ja mille keskel on auk.

clue_en: Light and chocolate batters are gently swirled so each slice has a streaked pattern in this bake. Name it.
clue_et: Heledat tainast ja šokolaaditainast segatakse kergelt, nii et selle küpsetise igas viilus on kirju muster. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Marble cake gets its streaked appearance by lightly mixing pale and chocolate batters.
explanation_et: Marmorikoogi kirju muster saadakse heleda ja šokolaadise taina kergest segamisest.

clue_en: Mashed ripe yellow fruit gives this moist loaf-shaped bake its name. Name it.
clue_et: Püreestatud küps kollane vili annab sellele niiskele pätsikujulisele küpsetisele nime. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Banana bread is a moist loaf-shaped bake made with mashed ripe bananas.
explanation_et: Banaanileib on niiske pätsikujuline küpsetis, mida tehakse püreestatud küpsetest banaanidest.

clue_en: After making a wish, people blow out these small wax sticks placed on a celebration cake. Name them.
clue_et: Pärast soovi lausumist puhutakse ära need väikesed vahapulgad, mis asetatakse pidupäevakoogile. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Birthday candles are placed on a cake and traditionally blown out after the celebrant makes a wish.
explanation_et: Sünnipäevaküünlad asetatakse koogile ning puhutakse tavaliselt ära pärast seda, kui sünnipäevalaps on soovi lausunud.

clue_en: This bright red preserved sweet fruit is placed on top of cakes or ice cream. Name it.
clue_et: See erkpunane säilitatud magus vili pannakse kookide või jäätise peale. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A cocktail cherry, also called a maraschino cherry, is a preserved sweet cherry placed as decoration on cakes, ice cream and drinks.
explanation_et: Kokteilikirss on säilitatud magus kirss, mida kasutatakse kookide, jäätise ja jookide kaunistamiseks.

clue_en: These colourful blossoms can decorate a cake and are safe for guests to eat. Name the decoration.
clue_et: Need värvilised õied võivad kooki kaunistada ja külalised võivad neid ohutult süüa. Nimeta need.
explanation_en: Edible flowers are blossoms that can safely be eaten and used to add colour and decoration to food.
explanation_et: Söödavad lilled on õied, mida võib ohutult süüa ning kasutada toidule värvi ja kaunistuse lisamiseks.

clue_en: This smooth sweet paste is rolled into a sheet and draped over a cake. Name it.
clue_et: See sile magus pasta rullitakse leheks ja asetatakse koogi peale. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Fondant is a smooth sweet paste that can be rolled flat and used to cover or decorate cakes.
explanation_et: Suhkrumass on sile magus pasta, mida saab lapikuks rullida ning kasutada kookide katmiseks või kaunistamiseks.

explanation_en: Flambéing ignites alcohol added to food.
explanation_et: Flambeerimisel süüdatakse toidule lisatud alkohol.

clue_en: What preparation step soaks food in a seasoned liquid before cooking?
clue_et: Milline ettevalmistusvõte leotab toitu enne küpsetamist maitsestatud vedelikus?
explanation_en: Marinating holds food in a seasoned liquid to add flavour and sometimes tenderise it.
explanation_et: Marineerimisel hoitakse toitu maitse andmiseks ja vahel pehmendamiseks maitsestatud vedelikus.

clue_en: What cooking action repeatedly spoons hot fat or juices over a roasting joint to moisten its surface?
clue_et: Milline kokandusvõte tõstab korduvalt kuuma rasva või leent küpsevale lihatükile, et selle pinda niisutada?
accepted_variants_en: Basting with juices;Basting with sauce;Moistening with juices
explanation_en: Basting coats cooking food with its juices or another liquid.
explanation_et: Kastmega niisutamisel kaetakse küpsev toit selle mahlade või muu vedelikuga.

clue_en: What French cutting term means reducing vegetables to thin matchstick-like strips?
clue_et: Milline prantsuse lõikamistermin tähendab köögiviljade lõikamist õhukesteks tikutaolisteks ribadeks?
explanation_en: Julienne cutting produces long thin strips resembling matchsticks.
explanation_et: Julienne-lõikus annab pikad õhukesed tikutaolised ribad.

clue_en: What Japanese packed meal is arranged in a compartmented lunch box?
clue_et: Milline Jaapani kaasa pakitud eine paigutatakse lahtritega lõunakarpi?
explanation_en: Bento is a Japanese boxed meal, often arranged in separated compartments.
explanation_et: Bento on Jaapani karbieine, sageli paigutatud eraldi lahtritesse.

clue_en: In which country do Mumbai’s dabbawalas deliver packed lunches in containers known as tiffin boxes?
clue_et: Millises riigis toimetavad Mumbai dabbawala’d lõunasööki kohale tiffin-karpideks nimetatud nõudes?
explanation_en: Mumbai’s dabbawalas deliver packed lunches in India, often in tiffin carriers.
explanation_et: Mumbai dabbawala’d toimetavad Indias kohale pakitud lõunasööke, sageli tiffin-nõudes.

clue_en: Which Eastern Mediterranean tradition offers a selection of small dishes often served with spirits?
clue_et: Milline Vahemere idaosa traditsioon pakub valikut väikestest roogadest, sageli kangete jookide kõrvale?
explanation_en: Meze is a selection of small dishes served as appetisers in the Eastern Mediterranean and nearby regions.
explanation_et: Meze on Vahemere idaosas ja lähialadel eelroana pakutav väikeste roogade valik.

clue_en: What Japanese informal bar serves drinks with a variety of small shared dishes?
clue_et: Milline Jaapani vaba õhkkonnaga baar pakub jooke koos eri väikeste jagatavate roogadega?
explanation_en: An izakaya is an informal Japanese bar serving drinks and food.
explanation_et: Izakaya on vaba õhkkonnaga Jaapani baar, kus pakutakse jooke ja toitu.

clue_en: Which Swedish meal tradition spreads out numerous hot and cold dishes for guests to choose from?
clue_et: Milline Rootsi einestamistraditsioon seab välja palju sooje ja külmi roogi, mille hulgast külalised valivad?
explanation_en: A smörgåsbord offers a selection of hot and cold dishes buffet-style.
explanation_et: Rootsi laud pakub valikuks sooje ja külmi roogi.

clue_en: Which lever-like tool removes a crimped metal crown cap from a bottle?
clue_et: Milline kangitaoline tööriist eemaldab pudelilt sakilise metallkorgi?
explanation_en: A bottle opener removes metal crown caps by leverage.
explanation_et: Pudeliavaja eemaldab metallist kroonkorke kangi põhimõttel.

clue_en: What serving vessel receives wine poured from its bottle, often to separate it from sediment?
clue_et: Millisesse serveerimisnõusse valatakse pudelist veini, sageli sette eraldamiseks?
explanation_en: A decanter holds wine after decanting, which can separate wine from sediment.
explanation_et: Karahvin hoiab ümbervalatud veini, mille saab nii settest eraldada.

clue_en: What small mat under a drink protects the table from moisture rings?
clue_et: Milline väike jooginõu alla pandav alus kaitseb lauda niiskusrõngaste eest?
explanation_en: A coaster protects a surface beneath a drinking vessel.
explanation_et: Klaasialus kaitseb jooginõu all olevat pinda.

clue_en: Which mould freezes water into separate small blocks for cooling drinks?
clue_et: Milline vorm külmutab vee eraldi väikesteks tükkideks jookide jahutamiseks?
explanation_en: An ice cube tray forms separate ice cubes from water.
explanation_et: Jääkuubikuvorm valmistab veest eraldi jääkuubikud.

clue_en: What sealed bar tool mixes drinks by vigorous movement, usually with ice inside?
clue_et: Milline suletud baaritööriist segab jooke tugeva raputamisega, tavaliselt koos jääga?
explanation_en: A cocktail shaker mixes and chills ingredients by shaking them with ice.
explanation_et: Kokteilišeiker segab ja jahutab koostisosi neid koos jääga raputades.

clue_en: What shape does a Bundt cake get from a baking pan with a tube in the middle?
clue_et: Millise kuju saab Bundt-kook küpsetusvormilt, mille keskel on toru?
explanation_en: The central tube of a Bundt pan gives the cake a ring shape.
explanation_et: Bundt-vormi keskne toru annab koogile rõnga kuju.

clue_en: What person-shaped biscuit is the running hero of a familiar folk tale?
clue_et: Milline inimesekujuline küpsis on tuntud muinasjutu põgenev kangelane?
explanation_en: The gingerbread man is both a shaped biscuit and a folktale character.
explanation_et: Piparkoogimehike on nii kujundküpsis kui ka muinasjututegelane.

clue_en: Which long French cream-filled pastry has a name meaning lightning?
clue_et: Millise pikliku Prantsuse kreemitäidisega küpsetise nimi tähendab välku?
explanation_en: Éclair is a choux-pastry dessert whose French name means lightning.
explanation_et: Ekleer on keedutainast magusküpsetis, mille prantsuse nimi tähendab välku.

clue_en: Which small French sponge cake is baked in a shell-shaped mould?
clue_et: Milline väike Prantsuse biskviitkook küpsetatakse merekarbikujulises vormis?
explanation_en: Madeleines have a distinctive shell shape produced by their baking mould.
explanation_et: Madeleine'ide iseloomulik merekarbikuju tuleb küpsetusvormist.

clue_en: Which French puff-pastry biscuit is rolled into a shape resembling a palm leaf?
clue_et: Milline Prantsuse lehttainaküpsis rullitakse palmilehte meenutavasse kujusse?
explanation_en: A palmier is folded puff pastry shaped like a palm leaf or elephant ear.
explanation_et: Palmier on kokkuvolditud lehttainaküpsis palmilehe või elevandikõrva kujul.

clue_en: Which creamy holiday drink combines beaten eggs with milk or cream and may contain spirits?
clue_et: Milline kreemjas pühadejook ühendab lahtiklopitud munad piima või koorega ning võib sisaldada kanget alkoholi?
explanation_en: Eggnog contains eggs, milk or cream and sugar, with alcohol optional.
explanation_et: Munapuntš sisaldab mune, piima või koort ja suhkrut; alkoholi võib lisada.

clue_en: Which warm winter drink combines cocoa with milk and is often topped with marshmallows?
clue_et: Millises soojas talvejoogis ühendatakse kakao piimaga ning peale pannakse sageli vahukomme?
explanation_en: Hot chocolate or hot cocoa is a warmed chocolate drink; marshmallows are a familiar topping.
explanation_et: Kuum šokolaad ehk kuum kakao on soe šokolaadijook, millele lisatakse sageli vahukomme.

clue_en: Which fruit trees are blessed by singing during England’s orchard wassailing tradition?
clue_et: Milliseid viljapuid õnnistatakse Inglismaa wassailing-kombestikus neile lauldes?
explanation_en: Orchard wassailing blesses cider apple trees through singing to promote the coming harvest.
explanation_et: Viljapuuaia wassailing-kombestikus õnnistatakse lauldes siidriõunapuid, et soodustada tulevast saaki.

clue_en: Which Nordic festive drink is often served with raisins and almonds in the cup?
clue_et: Millist Põhjamaade pühadejooki serveeritakse sageli koos rosinate ja mandlitega tassis?
explanation_en: Glögg is a Nordic spiced drink commonly served with raisins and almonds.
explanation_et: Glögi on Põhjamaade vürtsijook, mida serveeritakse sageli rosinate ja mandlitega.

clue_en: Which French sparkling wine is mainly made from Chardonnay, Pinot noir and Pinot meunier?
clue_et: Milline Prantsuse vahuvein valmib peamiselt Chardonnay, Pinot noir'i ja Pinot meunier' viinamarjadest?
explanation_en: Chardonnay, Pinot noir and Pinot meunier supply almost all Champagne grapes.
explanation_et: Chardonnay, Pinot noir ja Pinot meunier annavad peaaegu kõik šampanja viinamarjad.

clue_en: What golden foam forms on top of a freshly pulled espresso?
clue_et: Milline kuldne vaht moodustub värskelt valmistatud espresso pinnale?
explanation_en: Crema is the foam at the surface of an espresso.
explanation_et: Crema on espresso pinnale tekkiv vaht.

clue_en: Which espresso drink has an Italian name meaning stained, referring to a little added milk?
clue_et: Millise espressojoogi itaaliakeelne nimi tähendab plekilist ja viitab väikesele piimalisandile?
explanation_en: Macchiato means stained and describes espresso marked with milk.
explanation_et: Macchiato tähendab plekilist ja kirjeldab väikese piimalisandiga espressot.

clue_en: Which coffee drink combines espresso with smooth microfoam and is associated with Australia and New Zealand?
clue_et: Milline kohvijook ühendab espresso peene piimavahuga ning seostub Austraalia ja Uus-Meremaaga?
explanation_en: Flat white is an espresso-and-microfoam drink associated with Australian and New Zealand café culture.
explanation_et: Flat white ühendab espresso peene piimavahuga ning seostub Austraalia ja Uus-Meremaa kohvikukultuuriga.

clue_en: What café craft pours milk foam to create hearts or leaves on a coffee's surface?
clue_et: Milline kohvikukunst loob piimavahu valamisel kohvi pinnale südameid või lehti?
explanation_en: Latte art creates surface patterns by pouring steamed milk into espresso.
explanation_et: Latte-kunst loob aurutatud piima espressosse valades pinnamustreid.

clue_en: Which Italian-derived job title describes a professional who prepares espresso drinks?
clue_et: Milline itaalia päritolu ametinimetus tähistab espressojookide valmistamise spetsialisti?
explanation_en: A barista is a specialist in preparing and serving coffee drinks.
explanation_et: Barista on kohvijookide valmistamise ja serveerimise spetsialist.

clue_en: What cooled, brewed drink is poured over ice and commonly sweetened?
clue_et: Millist jahutatud tõmmisjooki valatakse jää peale ja sageli magustatakse?
explanation_en: Iced tea is brewed, cooled and served over ice, often with added sugar.
explanation_et: Jäätee tõmmisel lastakse jahtuda ning seda serveeritakse jää peal, sageli lisatud suhkruga.

clue_en: Which carbonated mixer contains added mineral salts but lacks tonic water's bitter quinine?
clue_et: Milline gaseeritud segujook sisaldab lisatud mineraalsooli, kuid mitte tooniku mõru kiniini?
explanation_en: Club soda is carbonated water with added mineral salts.
explanation_et: Soodavesi on lisatud mineraalsooladega gaseeritud vesi.

clue_en: Malted milk powder combines wheat and milk with malt from which cereal grain?
clue_et: Millisest teraviljast saadud linnased ühendatakse linnasepiimapulbris nisu ja piimaga?
explanation_en: Malted milk powder combines malted barley, wheat flour and whole milk powder.
explanation_et: Linnasepiimapulber ühendab odralinnased, nisujahu ja täispiimapulbri.

clue_en: Which citrus fruit flavours a traditional British drink made by boiling pearl grains in water?
clue_et: Milline tsitrusvili maitsestab traditsioonilist Briti jooki, mida tehakse lihvitud terasid vees keetes?
explanation_en: This traditional British grain infusion is often flavoured with lemon juice.
explanation_et: Seda traditsioonilist Briti teraviljajooki maitsestatakse sageli sidrunimahlaga.

clue_en: Which Indian yoghurt drink can be sweet, salty or flavoured with mango?
clue_et: Milline India jogurtijook võib olla magus, soolane või mangoga maitsestatud?
explanation_en: Lassi is a yoghurt-based drink with sweet and savoury varieties.
explanation_et: Lassi on jogurtipõhine jook, millel on magusaid ja soolaseid variante.

clue_en: Which open-air drinking space grew especially famous in Bavaria?
clue_et: Milline vabaõhu joogikoht sai eriti kuulsaks Baierimaal?
explanation_en: Beer gardens are outdoor drinking and eating areas strongly associated with Bavaria.
explanation_et: Õlleaiad on väljas asuvad joogi- ja söögikohad, mis seostuvad eriti Baierimaaga.

clue_en: Which British drinking establishment has a name shortened from public house?
clue_et: Millise Briti joogikoha nimi on lühend väljendist public house?
explanation_en: Pub is an abbreviation of public house.
explanation_et: Pubi nimi tuleneb inglise väljendi public house lühendist.

clue_en: Which baked snack is served beside roast chicken and sausages in Oktoberfest’s Hofbräu tent?
clue_et: Millist küpsetatud suupistet serveeritakse Oktoberfesti Hofbräu telgis praekana ja vorstide kõrval?
explanation_en: Pretzels are among the traditional Bavarian foods served in Oktoberfest’s Hofbräu tent.
explanation_et: Soolakringlid kuuluvad Oktoberfesti Hofbräu telgis serveeritavate traditsiooniliste Baieri toitude hulka.

clue_en: Which Japanese drink is traditionally served in a small cup called a sakazuki?
clue_et: Millist Jaapani jooki serveeritakse traditsiooniliselt väikesest sakazuki-nimelisest tassist?
explanation_en: Sakazuki are traditional cups used for sake.
explanation_et: Sakazuki on traditsioonilised sake-tassid.

clue_en: Which Mexican spirit is commonly served around the world as a shot with salt and lime?
clue_et: Millist Mehhiko kanget alkoholi serveeritakse üle maailma sageli pitsina koos soola ja laimiga?
explanation_en: A common tequila-shot ritual uses salt and a slice of lime.
explanation_et: Levinud tekiilapitsi rituaalis kasutatakse soola ja laimiviilu.

clue_en: Which Italian city is the home of the pizza-making craft added to UNESCO's intangible heritage list in 2017?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia linn on koduks pitsavalmistamise kunstile, mis kanti 2017. aastal UNESCO vaimse pärandi nimekirja?
explanation_en: UNESCO recognises the art of Neapolitan pizzaiuoli, the pizza makers of Naples.
explanation_et: UNESCO tunnustab Napoli pitsameistrite ehk pizzaiuoli'de kunsti.

clue_en: Which farm animal supplies the milk used to make traditional Cheddar cheese?
clue_et: Millise kodulooma piimast tehakse traditsioonilist Cheddari juustu?
explanation_en: Traditional Cheddar cheese is made from cows’ milk.
explanation_et: Traditsiooniline Cheddari juust tehakse lehmapiimast.

clue_en: In which country are authentic Roquefort cheeses aged in the natural caves of Roquefort-sur-Soulzon?
clue_et: Millises riigis laagerdatakse ehtsat Roqueforti juustu Roquefort-sur-Soulzoni looduslikes koobastes?
explanation_en: Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, where Roquefort cheeses are aged in natural caves, is in France.
explanation_et: Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, mille looduslikes koobastes laagerdatakse Roqueforti juustu, asub Prantsusmaal.

clue_en: Which Burgundy city became a centre of French mustard making in the Middle Ages?
clue_et: Millisest Burgundia linnast kujunes keskajal Prantsuse sinepivalmistamise keskus?
explanation_en: Dijon became a recognised mustard-making centre during the Middle Ages.
explanation_et: Dijonist sai keskajal tuntud sinepivalmistamise keskus.

clue_en: In which English city did Lea and Perrins create their famous fermented sauce?
clue_et: Millises Inglismaa linnas lõid Lea ja Perrins oma kuulsa kääritatud kastme?
explanation_en: Lea and Perrins developed Worcestershire sauce in Worcester.
explanation_et: Lea ja Perrins töötasid Worcestershire'i kastme välja Worcesteris.

clue_en: Which pickled sushi accompaniment is eaten between pieces to refresh the palate?
clue_et: Millist marineeritud sušilisandit süüakse palade vahel maitsemeele värskendamiseks?
explanation_en: Gari is pickled young ginger used as a palate cleanser with sushi.
explanation_et: Gari on marineeritud noor ingver, mida kasutatakse suši juures maitsemeele värskendamiseks.

clue_en: What Spanish name describes the prized toasted rice crust at the bottom of a paella pan?
clue_et: Milline hispaaniakeelne nimi tähistab paellapanni põhja hinnatud röstitud riisikihti?
explanation_en: Socarrat is the crisp bottom layer of rice in a well-made paella.
explanation_et: Socarrat on hästi valmistatud paella põhjas olev krõbe riisikiht.

clue_en: Despite their association with Chinese-American restaurants, fortune cookies had nineteenth-century predecessors in which country?
clue_et: Kuigi õnneküpsised seostuvad Hiina-Ameerika restoranidega, valmistati nende eelkäijaid juba 19. sajandil millises riigis?
explanation_en: Nineteenth-century Japanese cookies near Kyoto contained written fortunes before the American form became widespread.
explanation_et: Kyoto ümbruse 19. sajandi Jaapani küpsised sisaldasid kirjalikke ennustusi enne Ameerika variandi levikut.

clue_en: What Scottish celebration serves haggis while reciting a poet's Address to a Haggis?
clue_et: Millisel Šoti tähistamisel serveeritakse haggis't luuletaja pöördumist selle roa poole lugedes?
explanation_en: A Burns supper honours Robert Burns and ceremonially serves haggis.
explanation_et: Burnsi õhtusöök austab Robert Burnsi ning serveerib pidulikult haggis't.

clue_en: Which square Vietnamese sticky-rice cake wrapped in leaves is traditionally made for Tết?
clue_et: Millist kandilist lehtedesse mähitud Vietnami kleepuva riisi kooki valmistatakse traditsiooniliselt Tếti pühaks?
explanation_en: Bánh chưng is a square sticky-rice cake traditionally associated with Tết.
explanation_et: Bánh chưng on kandiline kleepuva riisi kook, mis seostub traditsiooniliselt Tếti pühaga.

category_name_en: How a Kitchen Earns Its Name
clue_en: What French kitchen phrase means preparing and arranging ingredients before cooking begins?
clue_et: Milline prantsuse köögiväljend tähendab koostisosade ettevalmistamist ja paika seadmist enne kokkamist?
explanation_en: Mise en place means putting in place and describes organised preparation.
explanation_et: Mise en place tähendab paika seadmist ning kirjeldab organiseeritud ettevalmistust.

category_name_en: How a Kitchen Earns Its Name
clue_en: What hierarchical kitchen system divides professional work among specialised stations?
clue_et: Milline hierarhiline köögisüsteem jagab töö spetsialiseeritud tööpostide vahel?
explanation_en: The kitchen brigade system assigns distinct cooking responsibilities to ranked roles.
explanation_et: Köögibrigaadi süsteem jagab eri kokatööd kindla astmega ametikohtade vahel.

category_name_en: How a Kitchen Earns Its Name
clue_en: What is the highest restaurant rating in the Michelin Guide, defined as worth a special journey?
clue_et: Milline on Michelini teatmiku kõrgeim restoranihinnang, mida kirjeldatakse kui eraldi reisi väärt?
explanation_en: Three Michelin stars denote exceptional cuisine worth a special journey.
explanation_et: Kolm Michelini tärni tähistavad erakordset kööki, mille nimel tasub eraldi reis ette võtta.

category_name_en: How a Kitchen Earns Its Name
clue_en: Which annual American culinary honours are often likened to the Academy Awards of the food world?
clue_et: Milliseid iga-aastaseid Ameerika toidumaailma auhindu võrreldakse sageli filmiakadeemia Oscaritega?
explanation_en: The James Beard Foundation Awards recognise chefs, restaurateurs, food writers and other culinary professionals.
explanation_et: James Beardi fondi auhinnad tunnustavad kokki, restoranipidajaid, toidukirjanikke ja teisi toidumaailma tegijaid.

category_name_en: How a Kitchen Earns Its Name
clue_en: Which international cooking-school network has a French name meaning the blue ribbon?
clue_et: Millise rahvusvahelise kokakoolide võrgustiku prantsuskeelne nimi tähendab sinist linti?
explanation_en: Le Cordon Bleu's name translates as the blue ribbon.
explanation_et: Le Cordon Bleu nimi tähendab sinist linti.

clue_en: Who brought French cooking to American television through The French Chef?
clue_et: Kes tõi Prantsuse kokakunsti Ameerika televisiooni saates The French Chef?
explanation_en: Julia Child hosted The French Chef and popularised French cuisine in America.
explanation_et: Julia Child juhtis saadet The French Chef ning populariseeris Ameerikas Prantsuse kööki.

clue_en: Which Scottish-born chef presented Hell's Kitchen and Kitchen Nightmares?
clue_et: Milline Šotimaal sündinud kokk juhtis saateid Hell's Kitchen ja Kitchen Nightmares?
explanation_en: Gordon Ramsay is associated with both television series.
explanation_et: Gordon Ramsay on seotud mõlema telesarjaga.

clue_en: Which English baker judged The Great British Bake Off alongside Mary Berry before the programme moved to Channel 4?
clue_et: Milline Inglise pagar oli koos Mary Berryga The Great British Bake Offi kohtunik enne sarja kolimist Channel 4 kanalile?
explanation_en: Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry judged the original BBC series together; Hollywood stayed when it moved to Channel 4.
explanation_et: Paul Hollywood ja Mary Berry olid BBC sarjas koos kohtunikud; Hollywood jätkas ka pärast sarja kolimist Channel 4 kanalile.

clue_en: Which travelling chef wrote the memoir Kitchen Confidential and later presented Parts Unknown?
clue_et: Milline rändav kokk kirjutas mälestusteraamatu Kitchen Confidential ning juhtis hiljem saadet Parts Unknown?
explanation_en: Anthony Bourdain wrote Kitchen Confidential and hosted Parts Unknown.
explanation_et: Anthony Bourdain kirjutas Kitchen Confidentiali ja juhtis saadet Parts Unknown.

clue_en: Which cook wrote Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat and presented the series of the same name?
clue_et: Milline kokk kirjutas raamatu Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat ja juhtis samanimelist sarja?
explanation_en: Samin Nosrat wrote Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat and presented the Netflix series based on the book.
explanation_et: Samin Nosrat kirjutas raamatu Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat ning juhtis sellel põhinevat Netflixi sarja.

clue_en: Which Milanese festive bake is traditionally hung upside down after baking to prevent collapse?
clue_et: Milline Milano pühadeküpsetis riputatakse pärast küpsetamist tagurpidi, et see kokku ei vajuks?
explanation_en: Panettone is cooled upside down to maintain its airy shape.
explanation_et: Panettone jahutatakse tagurpidi, et säilitada õhuline kuju.

clue_en: Which British Easter fruitcake is often topped with eleven marzipan balls representing apostles?
clue_et: Millisele Briti lihavõtte-puuviljakoogile pannakse sageli üksteist apostleid tähistavat martsipanipalli?
explanation_en: Simnel cake traditionally carries eleven marzipan balls, excluding Judas.
explanation_et: Simnel-koogil on traditsiooniliselt üksteist martsipanipalli, Juudast arvestamata.

clue_en: Which German city has a historic Stollen festival with a giant version of its Christmas fruit bread?
clue_et: Millises Saksamaa linnas peetakse ajaloolist stollenifestivali hiiglasliku jõulu-puuviljasaiaga?
explanation_en: Dresden celebrates its stollen tradition with the Dresdner Stollenfest.
explanation_et: Dresden tähistab stollenitraditsiooni festivaliga Dresdner Stollenfest.

clue_en: Which French Epiphany pastry hides a fève and crowns the diner who finds it?
clue_et: Milline Prantsuse kolmekuningapäeva küpsetis peidab fève'i ning kroonib selle leidnud sööja?
explanation_en: Galette des rois contains a token whose finder is crowned king or queen.
explanation_et: Galette des rois peidab märki, mille leidja kroonitakse kuningaks või kuningannaks.

clue_en: Which Eastern European Easter bread shares its name with the holiday's traditional name?
clue_et: Milline Ida-Euroopa lihavõttesai jagab nime püha traditsioonilise nimetusega?
explanation_en: Paska is an Easter bread whose name derives from Pascha.
explanation_et: Paska on lihavõttesai, mille nimi pärineb sõnast Pascha.

clue_en: What French thickening base cooks flour with fat before liquid is added?
